description: This PHP class 'UpgraderConfigUtility' provides utility functions for checking the status and connection of a database during an upgrade process in the OrangeHRM system. It contains methods to verify the existence of upgrade status tables and to establish and verify database connections, throwing exceptions when checks fail.

classes.name: UpgraderConfigUtility
classes.description: Utility class providing database upgrade checks such as verifying the existence of upgrade status tables and validating database connections.

methods.name: checkDatabaseStatus
methods.description: Checks if the 'ohrm_upgrade_status' table exists in the database, indicating the upgrade status.

methods.name: getConnection
methods.description: Retrieves the current database connection instance.

methods.name: getSchemaManager
methods.description: Obtains the schema manager object to access database schema metadata.

methods.name: checkDatabaseConnection
methods.description: Checks the database connection for errors and whether the database is in a proper state for upgrade, throwing exceptions if issues are found.
